text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ……Defeat……!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, that was totally lacklustre!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I should have given it everything I had, 
and yet, somehow..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Classic Triple Crown 
route... Every competitor is a fierce 
contender. Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, we start from here! We might have 
missed the Triple Crown, but it's not over 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Racing up close with a formidable rival 
like Bourbon-san helped me pick up on some 
of her habits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why... it's okay! We definitely 
have a shot at winning the Nihon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm, is that... Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Failing to win the Satsuki Sho... means 
the Triple Crown is now impossible. My 
father's and my one and only dream is—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Oxygen supply levels lower than normal. 
Cause unknown. Executing deep breaths 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*... *exhale*... *inhale*... 
*exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
... ...Phew... ...Next is the Japanese 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if the result is defeat, I cannot 
afford to let my legs stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon hurried on her way home. As 
if chasing after her... a small shadow 
came running up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...—No, this isn't the time to be 
worrying, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san, and everyone else too... I 
know they'll be even stronger next time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Before the Nippon Derby, Rice has to get 
much, much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I've gotta give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san, Bourbon-san... They had such 
determined looks in their eyes."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, in today's Satsuki 
Sho, Rice-san was, how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It had this unique intensity to it...! 
Like, whooooah, whoa-choooo... kind of 
vibe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I bet she'll push even harder in the 
Nippon Derby and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now we really can't let our guard down. 
All right, I'm gonna give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that is why, Trainer! Let's go eat 
some ramen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Because I was hungry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while slurping shio ramen at a 
randomly chosen noodle shop—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee! Another noodle refill, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up once again for the upcoming 
Nippon Derby!
